caseNameFull: Moore, Director of Fisheries of the State of Washington v. United States
attorneys: Smith Troy, Attorney General of the State of Washington, and Harold A. Pebbles for petitioners. Acting Solicitor General Washington and Assistant Attorney General Bazelon for the United States. Kenneth R. L. Simmons filed a brief for the Quillayute Tribe of Indians, as amicus curiae, opposing the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
